title: Panniculitis analysis workflow - code for: Spatial mapping reveals convergent cytotoxic inflammation and divergent immune architectures in panniculitis
description: R (workflowr) code for the imaging mass cytometry, NanoString nCounter and immunofluorescence analyses and for generating the figures of the manuscript 'Spatial mapping reveals convergent cytotoxic inflammation and divergent immune architectures in panniculitis'. Patient data are not included (restricted access, see the Data Availability statement of the paper).
